title: Native Cache Abi21 Reload
objective: Diagnose and fix immediate stale-cache rejection after ABI 21 native compilation without weakening cache validation

handoff.summary: Synchronized the runtime's strict native-kernel ABI expectation with compiler ABI 21. Added an immediate fresh-cache compile and strict-load regression covering packed prime-field polynomial and dense prime-field matrix kernels; both compile into one new cache and reload as compiled without weakening stale checks.
next_steps: Rerun the polynomial performance audit against the integrated ABI 21 runtime.
